cmd.arch.wall_pick.desc: Places a wall on a picked drawing line of the current level. F switches axis or face on the line, Tab takes the connected chain. Each pick is one undo step. Works for curtain walls too.
hint.wall_pick.center: Wall by line: pick a drawing line · axis on the line · F face · Tab chain · Esc exit
hint.wall_pick.face: Wall by line: pick a drawing line · face on the line, cursor side · F axis · Tab chain · Esc exit
hint.wall_pick.center_chain: Wall by line: pick a line to take its chain · axis on the line · F face · Tab one line
hint.wall_pick.face_chain: Wall by line: pick a line to take its chain · face on the line · F axis · Tab one line
wall_pick.st.start: Pick a drawing line. F: axis or face, Tab: connected chain
wall_pick.st.no_lines: No visible drawing lines on this level
wall_pick.st.on_wall: This line is already under wall {id}
wall_pick.st.tight: The face offset does not fit: a segment of the chain is shorter than the wall thickness
